name: Believe ~Shitsuyoku no Tenshi-tachi~
source:
Main character is an excellent student trusted all over the school. However, one day he gets to die. A mysterious man appears before him and says that protagonist's soul can be pardoned in exchange for 200 million yen. The end date is his next birthday. But how is protagonist supposed to gather such an outrageous sum of money with just working part-time at a coffee shop? He finds a way out. He starts to lure his friends at coffee shop basement and there train girls into slaves.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是全校信赖的优秀学生。然而，有一天他会死。一个神秘人出现在他面前，并表示只要两亿日元就可以赦免主角的灵魂。结束日期是他的下一个生日。但主角光是在咖啡店打工，怎么可能赚到如此巨额的钱呢？他找到了出路。他开始在咖啡店地下室引诱他的朋友，并在那里训练女孩成为奴隶。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-april-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
